outcome: risk of metabolic diseases in women with gestational diabetes
cohort: 8928 pregnant women with gestational diabetes from the Xi'an Longitudinal Mother-Child Cohort Study (XAMC)
finding: The study found that pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity and late-pregnancy high HbA1c increased the risk of other gestational metabolic diseases in women with GDM, emphasizing the importance of monitoring and controlling HbA1c, especially in those with pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity.
